approaches_tried.approach: column-interleaving avg-glued-length vs whole-document median (literal research spec)
approaches_tried.reason: Empirically fails to flag the real motivating Alur corpus bug case: when gluing affects the majority of a document, glued lines dominate and inflate the document median itself, so the ratio check never fires (verified: 79% lines glued yet ratio stayed ~1.0x).

deviations.description: Column-interleaving detector: avg glued line length vs document median
deviations.reason: The literal research-spec formula (vs whole-document median) fails to flag the actual known-bad Alur SyGuS corpus document because glued lines dominate the document and inflate the median itself. Fixed by comparing against the median of NON-glued lines instead (falling back to whole-document median only if literally every line is glued). Re-verified against the real bad document (now correctly flagged) and against every successful conversion produced in this task (no false positives).
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — baseline changed from whole-document median to non-glued-lines median; see plan Phase 5 deviation note)*
